skyswinger.configuration.title: Sky Swinger Settings
skyswinger.configuration.maxSpeed.toolti: Fastest you can go while swinging.
skyswinger.configuration.swingKeep.toolt: Speed kept each tick while swinging. 1.0 means you never slow down.
skyswinger.configuration.pumpStrength.to: How hard W/A/S/D pumps your swing.
skyswinger.configuration.anchorHeight.to: How many blocks above you the web attaches.
skyswinger.configuration.useBlocksIfAime: Attach to a block if you're aiming at one overhead.
skyswinger.configuration.releaseBoost.to: Extra speed when you let go of the web.
skyswinger.configuration.glideSeconds.to: How many seconds your speed carries after letting go.
skyswinger.configuration.glideKeep.toolt: Speed kept each tick while gliding. Normal Minecraft is 0.91.
skyswinger.configuration.zipSpeed.toolti: How fast web zip pulls you.
skyswinger.configuration.zipUses.tooltip: How many zips you get before the cooldown.
skyswinger.configuration.whooshSound.too: Wind sound that gets louder the faster you go.
skyswinger.configuration.animations.tool: Swing, zip and arm animations. See them in third person (F5).
skyswinger.configuration.speedFov.toolti: Widen your view when you go fast.
skyswinger.configuration.webFadeOut.tool: Webs go slack and fade after you let go.
skyswinger.configuration.showHud.tooltip: Show the web and zip display.
skyswinger.configuration.hudCorner.toolt: Which corner of the screen the display goes in.
skyswinger.configuration.shots.tooltip: How many web shots you get before the cooldown.
skyswinger.configuration.damage.tooltip: Damage per web shot. 1 is half a heart.
skyswinger.configuration.webLeap.tooltip: How high you leap when you shoot a web from the ground. 0 turns it off.
skyswinger.configuration.releaseFlips.to: Do a flip automatically when you let go at high speed.
skyswinger.configuration.showScore.toolt: Show praise words, landings and level-ups.
skyswinger.configuration.diveBoost.toolt: Look straight down while falling to dive faster.
skyswinger.configuration.spaceFlips.tool: Tap Space in the air for a front flip. S + Space does a backflip.
skyswinger.configuration.trapSeconds.too: How many seconds a web trap holds a mob.
skyswinger.configuration.swingKickDamage: Damage for each unit of speed. Faster swings hit harder.
skyswinger.configuration.smartAnchors.to: Webs stick to tall buildings near you instead of the sky when there are any.
skyswinger.configuration.wallRun.tooltip: Hold Sprint on a wall to run along it (needs the Wall Run skill).
skyswinger.configuration.cameraTilt.tool: The camera leans into turns while you swing.
skyswinger.configuration.windStreaks.too: Wind streaks at the edges of the screen when you go fast.
skyswinger.configuration.dangerSense.too: The edge of your screen flashes when a mob or arrow is about to hit you.
skyswinger.configuration.showTutorial.to: Show the tutorial tips. Turn off and on again to restart them.
skyswinger.configuration.requireWebShoot: Survival players need a Web Shooter in their inventory to use webs.
skyswinger.configuration.useWebFluid.too: Web shots use web fluid. Refill with Web Cartridges.
skyswinger.configuration.fallDamageReduc: How much less fall damage you take with a Web Shooter. 0.75 means 75% less.
skyswinger.configuration.unlockAllSkills: Unlock every skill for testing. Creative mode always has everything.
skyswinger.configuration.wallCrawl.toolt: Stick to walls and ceilings and crawl on them.
skyswinger.configuration.cameraRoll.tool: Camera turns sideways on walls, upside down on ceilings, and when you loop over a swing.
skyswinger.configuration.invertCameraRol: Turn this on if the camera rolls the wrong way.
skyswinger.configuration.requireBite.too: Players need to be bitten by a Strange Spider (or /skyswinger bite) to have powers.
